```{python}
import scanpy as sc
import numpy as np
import anndata as ad
import pandas as pd
import os
```

```{python}
adatas = []

base_dir = "../CARPALL_cohort_3_raw/"
file_names = os.listdir(base_dir)


sample_folders = [f for f in os.listdir(base_dir) if f.startswith("Sample")]

adatas = []

for folder in sample_folders:
    sample_dir = os.path.join(base_dir, folder)
    cellbender_path = os.path.join(
        sample_dir,
        "cellbender_output_filtered.h5"
    )

    print(f"\nProcessing {folder}")

    sample_id = folder

    adata = sc.read_10x_h5(cellbender_path)
    adata.var_names_make_unique()

    adata.obs_names = [f"{sample_id}_{bc}" for bc in adata.obs_names]
    adata.obs["file_id"] = sample_id
    adata.layers["counts"] = adata.X.copy()

    adatas.append(adata)
```

# combine into one adata
```{python}
carpall3 = sc.concat(
    adatas,
    label="file_id",
    keys=sample_folders
)
```

# make a carpall column to can distinguish/batch correct easily down the line
```{python}
carpall3.obs["study"] = "carpall_three"
```
